title: Sharknative open data: maker-published spec tables for countertop appliances, castable sonar, office espresso machines, first 3D printers, small-space fitness gear and automatic litter boxes
description:
Open CC BY 4.0 spec tables behind six product-research tools. Each table holds maker-published specifications with a source URL per cell; cells with no published figure are left blank. Every dataset folder has the CSV, the JSON and a README with the source page, the gathering method and a citation line. The canonical, latest copy of each table lives on its page:

  • Countertop appliance heights and cabinet clearances (CounterTopCheck)
  • Castable Sonar Spec Index (AnglerLeague)
  • Office espresso machine data (CremaCheck)
  • First-printer data (FirstPrintCheck)
  • Small-Space Fitness Index (Wellness Rundown)
  • Automatic litter box spec table (VettedFur)
